note: Classifier stage-1 spectrum: five coarse buckets scored by a System-1 decision model (Kev). The character model unpacks nuance (which emotion, attribution, time) from the complete source text; the classifier only routes. One call per article via llama.cpp /v1/systemone.

relevance.instructions: Relationship of the candidate target to this reporting.

criteria.direct_subject: the target is a direct subject of a reported event, assertion or reaction
criteria.opponent_context: the target is an opponent or contextual counterparty in another subject's reporting
criteria.incidental_mention: the target is only mentioned incidentally

emotional_charge.instructions: Does the text carry emotional charge — hope, anger, joy, worry, relief or frustration — rather than flat reporting? Apathy is not emotional charge.

availability.instructions: Does this report discuss the target's physical availability — injury, fitness or suspension?

movement.instructions: Is a transfer, trade, signing or departure involving the target discussed?

staffing.instructions: Does this report discuss a coaching or staff appointment, sacking or role change?

scout.note: Nomination only; Scout still requires an applied structured record.

journalist.note: Broad: any reporting whose target is a direct subject.
